//! Production constants, one of them a live push endpoint nobody registered.

/// Registered in the audit's table under the real name, so the scan is quiet
/// about it here too.
pub const COMMUNITY_PUSH_SOURCE: &str = "https://push.chocolatey.org/";

/// Unregistered: a new publisher's compiled-in host.
pub const DEMO_PUSH_SOURCE: &str = "https://push.demo-registry.dev/";

/// A loopback default is reachable only by the developer who started the
/// responder, so it needs no row.
pub const DEMO_LOCAL_SOURCE: &str = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v2/package";

/// A URL in prose is not a declaration:
/// `const DEMO_DOC_SOURCE: &str = "https://push.doc-registry.dev/";`
pub fn push_source(custom: Option<&str>) -> &str {
    custom.unwrap_or(DEMO_PUSH_SOURCE)
}
